en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting a small railway station with wooden buildings beside train tracks. Several people stand on the platform and on the slope behind the station. The main station building has a sign reading "MELLÖSA" and various advertisements on the facade. The caption at the bottom identifies the station and region, and credits the photographer/publisher.
